questions.questionText: What is a characteristic of all living organisms?
Which statement about the binomial naming system is correct?

options.text: It is used for naming animal species but not plant species.
It is an internationally agreed scientific naming system.
The name of a species is different in different countries.
The name consists of one or two words.

questions.questionText:
Scientists discover a new species of animal.
It has a segmented body with two pairs of legs on each segment.
To which group of animals does this new species belong?
In which part of a cell does photosynthesis take place?

The diagram shows some of the blood vessels and other structures in the human body.
The blood vessels shown are all parts of the same
By which process do oxygen and carbon dioxide move between cells and capillaries?
Which element is found in proteins but not carbohydrates?

Starch is digested by amylase in the mouth, but it is not digested in the stomach.
What is the reason for this?

options.text: All starch digestion is completed in the mouth.
The pH in the stomach is not suitable for the amylase to work.
The starch does not stay in the stomach long enough to be digested.
The temperature in the stomach is not suitable for the amylase to work.

questions.questionText: Which type of molecule are enzymes made of?
In humans, where does most of the absorption of digested food take place?
What is the cause of the start of dental decay?
Which statement correctly identifies the enzyme and the products of fat digestion?

options.text: Fats are digested by lipase to form amino acids and glycerol.
Fats are digested by lipase to form fatty acids and glycerol.
Fats are digested by protease to form amino acids.
Fats are digested by protease to form fatty acids and glycerol.

a fast reaction involving the nervous system

questions.questionText:
Changes occur in a boy’s body at puberty; his height increases, more muscle develops and body
hair grows.
Which hormone stimulates these changes?
By which process is genetic information transmitted from generation to generation?

Some reptiles can lose and regrow their tails to avoid predation.
Which process occurs to regrow the tail?
What is an adaptive feature of an organism?

options.text: any feature that is not changed by the environment
any inherited feature that helps an organism to survive and reproduce
any feature that shows discontinuous variation
any inherited feature that an organism has

all the arachnids in a garden
all the arthropods in the world

questions.questionText: What is an example of genetic engineering?

options.text: the addition of vitamins to food to increase the nutritional benefits
the breeding of sheep with thick wool by choosing animals with desired characteristics
the insertion of genes into crop plants to make them resistant to insect pests
the production of biofuels by yeast cells

questions.questionText: What happens when deforestation takes place?

options.text: The number of habitats is increased.
The number of species becoming extinct is increased.
The possibility of flooding is decreased.

The volume of soil present is increased.
